row: Veterinary physiotherapist in Greater Manchester and Cheshire area. I provide excellence in physiotherapy for animals through a holistic, multidisciplinary approach.  I aim to provide treatments to competition animals, both equine and canine, as well as much loved leisure and companion animals, with care and respect.
